title: Alice Springs: Two-Week Outback Base
summary: Live and work in the Red Centre for two weeks rather than treating the outback as a short attraction circuit. Alice Springs has the housing, groceries, airport, car hire and daily-life infrastructure needed for a credible base, while Tjoritja/West MacDonnell Ranges and the East MacDonnell Ranges make the complete middle weekend genuinely distinctive.

season.summary: September is one of the strongest Alice Springs windows: warm, dry days and cool nights before October heat builds.
notes: Pack warm layers for early mornings and evenings as well as sun protection for afternoons.
The low monthly rainfall average does not eliminate isolated storms or strong winds.
Carry water on every excursion and avoid treating dry-weather averages as permission to improvise remote drives.

base.recommendation: East Side or the quieter edge of the town centre
base.reason: East Side offers a more residential rhythm, access to the Telegraph Station and trails, and a short drive to groceries and central services. A central-edge property can work if it provides better workspace, security, laundry and internet.
requirements: At least two bedrooms plus a closed-door workspace
Verified fixed broadband and strong mobile backup
Air conditioning, heating, kitchen and laundry
Secure parking for a rental car
A shaded outdoor area or pool
Written confirmation that the desk and internet are suitable for repeated video calls

localPlan: Use a substantial local-morning block for deep work while the children homeschool.
Keep most afternoons available for nearby town, cultural and outdoor activities.
When live U.S. overlap is needed, 6–10 a.m. New York maps to approximately 7:30–11:30 p.m. in Alice Springs.
Do not schedule late overlap every night; protect sleep before driving days.

workdayAfternoons.title: Alice Springs Desert Park
workdayAfternoons.note: Best used as a substantial half-day rather than squeezed into an hour; choose a lighter workday or weekend if program times require it.

workdayAfternoons.title: Alice Springs Telegraph Station
workdayAfternoons.note: Close to East Side and suitable for history, trails and a lower-friction afternoon.

workdayAfternoons.title: Araluen Cultural Precinct
workdayAfternoons.note: Use galleries and cultural collections as a heat, wind or recovery-day option.

workdayAfternoons.title: Royal Flying Doctor Service and School of the Air
workdayAfternoons.note: High-value family learning, subject to published tour hours.

workdayAfternoons.title: Olive Pink Botanic Garden and Anzac Hill
workdayAfternoons.note: Short, flexible outings for local ecology and sunset views.

workdayAfternoons.title: Ordinary town life
workdayAfternoons.note: Groceries, pool time, cooking and unprogrammed evenings are part of the purpose of a two-week stay.

middleWeekend.recommendation: Keep the Alice Springs rental and use two day trips rather than moving the work base.
preferredPlan: Saturday: Tjoritja/West MacDonnell Ranges, choosing a realistic line such as Simpsons Gap, Standley Chasm and one farther gorge rather than attempting every stop.
Sunday: a second West MacDonnell focus, East MacDonnell Ranges, Desert Park or a slower town day according to weather and family energy.
middleWeekend.alternative: Use one overnight west of town only if it materially improves the selected walks and the accommodation is operating; do not add Uluru casually.

uluruDecision.status: Not included in the canonical two-week base
uluruDecision.reason: Uluru is roughly a separate three-night vacation decision. Adding it automatically would consume leave, create another lodging move and weaken the ordinary-life purpose of Alice Springs.
revisitIf: The family considers Uluru a non-negotiable Australian objective
At least two additional vacation weekdays are available
The route can use a one-way Alice Springs → Uluru → Sydney flight pattern

homeschool: Arrernte history, living culture and the limits of outsider interpretation
Desert ecology, water, geology and adaptation
Royal Flying Doctor Service, School of the Air and the logistics of remote communities
Australian exploration, telegraphy and the contested history of settlement
Distance, fuel, heat, route planning and remote-area decision-making
bookFirst: Fourteen-night family rental with verified workspace and broadband
Melbourne → Alice Springs and Alice Springs → Sydney flights
Rental car for the full stay
Any timed Desert Park, School of the Air or cultural programs
Middle-weekend plan after checking park access and road conditions
